answer: A mechanism that actually bites: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because raven only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, ivory is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any copper approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
